# Retro GTA Workshop

All-in-one editor for the top-down GTAs: GTA1 (PC) and GTA2.

Companion tool to [IMG Factory 1.6](https://github.com/X-Seti/Img-Factory-1.6).

## Features
- Game folder: GTA1 GTADATA (.cmp maps, .g24 styles) or GTA2 data (.gmp maps, .sty styles, .mmp descriptions)
- Top-down map view: zoom, pan, top lids or one level, block grid, zones
- Block editor: lid / left / right / top / bottom tiles, rotation, flip, flat, wall, light, ground, slope, arrows
- Lid painting with undo
- Tiles: edit in DP5 Workshop and send back into the style
- Sprites: browse by group, export PNG
- Save map and style (backups first)

## Run
    ./launch_retro_gta_workshop.py [map or style file]
